description: Land Acquisition - Madupitiya, Bandaragama D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular parcel of land is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired, providing detailed descriptions of the land's location, boundaries, and extent. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition, which is a land and property-related matter.
